extraction_method: Local FastMCP.list_tools() after calling actual main() with FastMCP.run patched to capture server without starting transport; MCP 1.30.0, Pydantic 2.13.5. No tool execution or network tool calls.
limitations: Repository dependencies are lower-bounded, not locked; schema reflects installed MCP/Pydantic versions.
Runtime service success and trendspy response compatibility were not tested.

Independent dev-testing MCP prototypes excluded from production tool list; Claude prototype has five explicit schemas recorded separately; Aider prototype uses incompatible/nonexistent current MCP imports and decorator API, so exact registered schemas cannot be established.
reason: All four production registered tools and complete generated schemas verified; ask and discover implement Google Trends operations indirectly, with rolling-window historical keyword data and current US trending keywords, respectively.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Run the deterministic ask pipeline. Returns paths only.
tools.behavior: Multi-source topic research. When google_trends is selected (default includes it), uses topic as a single keyword; requests interest over time with global geo and rolling timeframe mapped from window_days (<=7: now 7-d; <=30: today 1-m; <=90: today 3-m; otherwise today 12-m), plus top related queries. Stores keyword, window_days, dates/value series and top_related as a raw blob. Trends is not converted to posts or passed into narrative summaries. Returns paths and short status, not Trends data.
validation_notes: sources schema is nullable array of unrestricted strings, not enum; implementation converts values to SourceKind (reddit, hn, indiehackers, google_trends), raising ValueError for unknown strings.
window_days and top_n have no schema bounds or explicit implementation positivity checks.
Ollama ping is mandatory; every source client is constructed even when its source is not selected.
summarizer is unrestricted string; copied into configuration/metadata, but ask always calls Ollama summarization and narration. No registered data_root or geo parameter.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Run the agentic discover loop. Returns paths only.
tools.behavior: Collects candidate titles from Reddit/HN and, if selected, current Google trending keywords through backend.trending_now(geo="US"), capped to top_n*2. Google candidate lookup ignores window_days and returns [] on unsupported backend/errors. Picks first top_n deduplicated candidates, runs ask pipeline for each subject within five aggregate iterations and 450-second aggregate elapsed check, writing linked summaries. Returns paths/status. Historical interest and related queries are collected in child ask runs.
validation_notes: sources schema is nullable array of unrestricted strings, not enum; implementation converts values to SourceKind (reddit, hn, indiehackers, google_trends), raising ValueError for unknown strings.
window_days and top_n have no schema bounds or explicit implementation positivity checks.
Ollama ping is mandatory; every source client is constructed even when its source is not selected.

tools.name: read_summary
tools.description: Read the summary.md from a run folder.
tools.behavior: Reads run_dir/summary/summary.md as UTF-8 and returns content or missing-file error. Does not read raw Google Trends data.
validation_notes: String paths/slugs have no format restrictions, traversal checks or existence constraints in schema; implementation only checks path.exists().

tools.name: read_timeline
tools.description: Read the timeline.md for a topic slug.
tools.behavior: Reads data/topics/{slug}/timeline.md as UTF-8 and returns content or missing-file error. Timeline is local run verdict history, not historical Google Trends series.
validation_notes: String paths/slugs have no format restrictions, traversal checks or existence constraints in schema; implementation only checks path.exists().
